wide_serve.g: Pull the returner off the court, then strike the gap they leave behind.

body_serve.g: Serve into the hip to cramp the swing and force a weak, predictable reply.

serve_plus_one.g: Serve to a target that sets up the forehand you already planned to hit.

down_the_line.g: Change direction at the right moment to wrong-foot a crosscourt rally.

inside_out.g: Run around the backhand to dictate the rally with your stronger wing.

crosscourt_build.g: The percentage shot — biggest target, lowest net. Build before you attack.

short_ball.g: Move in decisively on the short ball and take time away from your opponent.

net_approach.g: Approach behind the right ball, split, and close to finish at the net.

wide_open.g: The classic one-two: drag them out wide, then strike the space they leave.

serve_plus_one_fh.g: Serve to a target that sets up the forehand you already planned to hit.

body_jam_attack.g: Cramp the swing at the hip, then pounce on the weak floated reply.

kick_serve_pull.g: Kick it high and wide to drag them out, then open up the other side.

serve_volley.g: Take time away: serve, close, and finish the first volley into space.

chip_charge.g: Take the second serve early, chip it deep, and follow it to the net.

engineer_dtl.t: Two Heavy Crosscourts → Down the Line
engineer_dtl.g: Engineer the conditions first — only redirect once they are stretched wide.

inside_out_in.g: Pull them wide with inside-out, then flip it behind them inside-in.

open_then_behind.g: Drive them wide to commit their recovery, then wrong-foot them behind.

short_angle_finish.g: Earn it first: a short angle drags them off, then finish the open court.

drop_lob.g: Bring the deep-stander in with a drop, then lob over them.

moonball_approach.g: Push them behind the baseline with height, then pounce on the short reply.

poach.g: Serve to limit the return angle so your net player can cross and poach.
